current.name: Winter 2026 Research Forum
current.format: Online (Zoom or Google Meet). Selected finalists present to economics professors and answer questions.
current.eligibility: High school and university students from any country.
themes: Labor migration to Russia, South Korea, the Gulf and Europe
Regional inequality and households left behind

rubric.description: Is the question clear, focused and relevant to migration or remittances in Central Asia?
Are the data appropriate and the method sound, transparent and honestly reported?
Does the work tell us something new or useful, with conclusions that follow from the evidence?
Is the presentation clear, and does the presenter handle questions from the judges well?

awards: Potential publication as an SREI Working Paper for selected research
A mentorship session for first place
current.howToSubmit: Submit your paper or extended abstract through the submission form. You will receive a confirmation by email.

steps.title: Submit a 300-word abstract
steps.text: Describe your research question, data and method.

steps.title: Optional full paper
steps.text: Add a full paper if you have one. It is not required to apply.

steps.title: Finalists are invited
steps.text: Selected finalists are invited to present at the forum.

steps.title: Present and answer questions
steps.text: Present your research online and answer questions from academic reviewers.
